name: Sumeragi Hidaka
source:
"Hey... realize I'm putting my hand out... Aah Man! Hey walking over there is dangerous, I'm saying to come over here!"

Kirara’s curt but kind cousin
From Earth.

The cousin of the protagonist's friend Kirara.
He’s unsociable and hard to approach. 
He doesn't speak his mind freely, but he is kind at heart.
